passages.text: Equivalent fractions name the same amount. Multiplying the numerator and denominator by the same nonzero number preserves the ratio.
Steam engines supplied power to factories. Steam power allowed machinery to work away from fast-flowing rivers during industrialisation.
Factories attracted workers into towns. Urbanisation changed housing, transport and working conditions during industrialisation.
Food web arrows point from the organism being eaten to the consumer. The arrows represent the direction of energy transfer.
An ecosystem includes organisms, their physical surroundings and the interactions between them. A population contains members of one species.
Evaporation changes liquid water to water vapour. Condensation changes water vapour into liquid droplets when it cools.
DNA carries genetic information in cells. A gene is a section of DNA that contributes to a functional product.
Inertia describes resistance to a change of motion. With no resultant force, an object maintains constant velocity.
A programming loop repeats instructions. A loop condition controls whether another iteration runs and an update can move it towards termination.
A metaphor describes one thing as another to create a comparison. It can give a reader a new way to imagine an experience.
La photosynthèse utilise la lumière pour fabriquer de la matière organique. Les plantes absorbent du dioxyde de carbone et libèrent du dioxygène.
La evaporación transforma el agua líquida en vapor. La condensación transforma el vapor de agua en gotas líquidas.
A battery can drive an electric current around a complete circuit. Opening a switch interrupts the conducting path.

In a fictional club shop, 10 shirts sell for 12 pounds each. Revenue is 120 pounds. Each shirt costs 5 pounds to buy and print, so total costs are 50 pounds. Profit equals revenue minus costs: 70 pounds. Revenue is not profit. Break-even means revenue equals total costs and profit is zero.

Equivalent fractions describe the same amount of the same whole. Multiplying both parts of 3/4 by 3 gives 9/12. Multiplying both parts of 2/3 by 2 gives 4/6. Twelve twenty-fourths is one half, not three quarters.

In an idealised series circuit, a 6 volt battery supplies two resistors of 3 ohms each. Series resistances add to 6 ohms. Current equals voltage divided by resistance, so the current is 1 ampere. This model assumes the resistor values remain fixed.

In a fictional town, a diary says rain delayed one canal delivery in May. A ledger records deliveries in every month. The diary supports a delay on that occasion; it does not establish that rain caused all annual losses. Comparing dates and multiple sources helps test the broader claim.
The sentence "The classroom was a zoo" uses a metaphor to suggest noise and disorder. It does not mean that literal animals were present. The word "was" places this description in the past.
La frase "El agua se evapora cuando hace calor" describe un proceso general en presente. "Ayer llovió" describe un evento pasado. En inglés, ayer significa yesterday.
